verdict.rationale: Navan documents an official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.navan.com/mcp. It gives setup instructions for Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code, authenticates through the user's Navan login with that user's permissions, and exposes tools for querying spend, travel, policy and card data. A probe confirmed the developer portal's llms.txt and the MCP docs page are live. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the hosted MCP server works as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Navan MCP lets you connect Navan to your favorite AI products, so you can query Navan spend and travel data using natural language.
claude mcp add --transport http --scope user navan https://mcp.navan.com/mcp
All clients connect to the same hosted MCP server — auth, TLS, and updates are handled for you.
Authentication uses your Navan login (SSO or username/password) under the signed-in user's permissions.
